requirements.title: Original files are never deleted, edited, or truncated
requirements.currentText: The app never deletes or edits original files.
requirements.proposedText: The app never deletes, edits, or truncates an original archive file.
requirements.testNotes: Static read-only guard; no direct Vitest assertion yet.
requirements.notes: This is the core promise. The quarantine exception must not weaken it.

requirements.title: Only the duplicate quarantine mover may move or rename an original file
requirements.currentText: Original files are never moved, renamed, edited, or deleted.
requirements.proposedText: The only operation that may move or rename an original file is the duplicate quarantine mover, after explicit confirmation. Every other source operation is read-only.
requirements.testNotes: Covers the mover and the confirmed cleanup service; not yet ID-tagged.
requirements.notes: The README, acceptance row 2, scan contract, other-files contract, and security review still state the old absolute rule.

requirements.title: Every non-quarantine source read opens the original file read-only
requirements.currentText: Source files are opened with read access only, except by the quarantine mover.
requirements.proposedText: Scan, metadata, thumbnails, hashing, validation, media playback, and replication open source files read-only. Only the quarantine mover may open a source file for a rename.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests exercise the readers, but none asserts the open mode directly.
requirements.notes: A direct open-mode assertion would make this invariant stronger than a code review.

requirements.title: The quarantine mover is the only source write path
requirements.currentText: The read-only guard allows only the quarantine mover to rename source files.
requirements.proposedText: The quarantine mover is the only source write path. It is reachable only through the confirmed cleanup operation, and every other source write is rejected by the guard.
requirements.testNotes: Covers the mover and the cleanup handler; the static guard is separate.
requirements.notes: The security review allowlist does not yet name the quarantine mover.

requirements.title: The read-only guard fails on unreviewed write APIs
requirements.currentText: A static read-only guard fails the build if direct filesystem write calls appear outside the reviewed allowlist.
requirements.proposedText: The read-only guard fails the quality gate when a direct filesystem write API appears outside the reviewed allowlist. The allowlist names every permitted writer and is reviewed with the security review.
requirements.testNotes: The guard is the gate itself; it is not a Vitest test.
requirements.notes: The guard is defense-in-depth, not the primary runtime control.

requirements.title: The DB worker is the only SQLite writer
requirements.currentText: The DB worker is the single SQLite writer for both databases. The main process never opens SQLite directly.
requirements.proposedText: The DB worker is the only SQLite writer for the app database and the active catalog. Main and renderer never open SQLite directly.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the worker protocol and catalog registry; dependency-cruiser enforces the import boundary.
requirements.notes: The boundary is also enforced by .dependency-cruiser.cjs.

requirements.title: No IPC contract accepts a source path for writing
requirements.currentText: No replication IPC accepts a source path for writing.
requirements.proposedText: No IPC contract accepts a source path for writing outside the quarantine operation. Renderer requests use catalog IDs, never arbitrary filesystem paths.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover sender trust and contract shapes; no single test scans every IPC contract for source paths.
requirements.notes: A contract-wide scan could become a traceability check later.

requirements.title: The source catalog database may be written; source archive files may not
requirements.currentText: Source files remain unmodified; only the source archive's catalog database is written.
requirements.proposedText: The app writes the source archive's catalog database and app-managed caches. It does not write source archive files, except for the quarantine mover.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover read-only database connections and the source index.
requirements.notes: This is the wording that lets replication write metadata without weakening the source-file promise.

requirements.title: Scans exclude app-managed directories
requirements.currentText: Scans exclude `.memorylane`; `.memorylane_quarantine` is also excluded.
requirements.proposedText: Scans exclude both `.memorylane` and `.memorylane_quarantine` so app-managed data is never cataloged as archive content.
requirements.testNotes: The enumerator test creates a quarantine folder and asserts it is skipped.

requirements.title: Backups and validation read source data read-only
requirements.currentText: Backups open both databases read-only and use SQLite's backup API.
requirements.proposedText: Backups and validation open source databases and files read-only. Backups use SQLite's online backup API, not a live file copy.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the read-only connection and backup runner.

requirements.title: Duplicate groups are exact full-SHA-256 groups
requirements.currentText: Duplicate files are detected by SHA-256 and shown with all locations.
requirements.proposedText: Duplicate groups contain only files with the same full SHA-256 and list every present copy.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover exact grouping and the cleanup domain.

requirements.title: The keeper is a verified backup copy first, then the oldest copy
requirements.currentText: The keeper is a verified backup copy first. If several copies are covered, the oldest covered copy wins, then oldest modified, then shallower and shorter path, then shorter name, then lower file ID.
requirements.proposedText: The keeper is a verified backup copy first. If several copies are covered, the oldest covered copy wins; otherwise the oldest copy wins. Remaining tiebreakers are oldest modified, shallower and shorter path, shorter name, then lower file ID.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the keeper comparator and covered-copy promotion.

requirements.title: Coverage is a preference, not an eligibility gate
requirements.currentText: Verified backup coverage is not required. A group with no covered copy is eligible, but the confirmation and completion screens warn that the quarantine folder is not a backup until it is copied elsewhere.
requirements.proposedText: Coverage is a preference, not an eligibility gate. A group with no covered copy remains eligible and is shown with a warning that the quarantine folder is not a backup until it is copied elsewhere.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover uncovered-group eligibility and the warning UI.

requirements.title: The duplicates view shows KEEP/MOVE and SKIP with a reason
requirements.currentText: The page shows KEEP / MOVE badges for eligible groups and SKIP plus the reason for groups that fail a gate.
requirements.proposedText: The duplicates view shows KEEP and MOVE badges for eligible groups, and SKIP with the reason for every group that fails a gate.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate component and E2E tests cover keeper badges and skip reasons.

requirements.title: The confirmation states the full consequence
requirements.currentText: The confirmation requires an explicit acknowledgement and reports how many groups have no verified backup.
requirements.proposedText: The confirmation shows the counts, keeper rule, quarantine path, skip rules, required acknowledgement, and how many groups have no verified backup.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the dialog and the required acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Progress shows moved files, bytes, current path, and cancel
requirements.currentText: Progress shows files/bytes moved, current path, and cancel-after-current.
requirements.proposedText: Progress shows files and bytes moved, the current path, and a cancel action that stops after the current file.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover progress state and cancel-after-current.

requirements.title: Completion states the manual next steps
requirements.currentText: Completion shows moved/skipped totals and the manual next steps: back up the quarantine folder, remove it, rescan.
requirements.proposedText: Completion shows moved and skipped totals and the manual next steps: back up the quarantine folder, remove it, and rescan.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover completion state and totals.

requirements.title: The mover verifies before and after the move
requirements.currentText: The mover re-checks the keeper and every candidate with full SHA-256 immediately before the same-volume move. After the move it hashes the quarantined copy again. A mismatch is moved back to the source path and journaled; if the restore fails, the run aborts.
requirements.proposedText: The mover re-hashes the source immediately before the move and the quarantined copy immediately after. A mismatch restores the source and journals the restore; if the restore fails, the run aborts.
requirements.testNotes: The mover test restores a file when the quarantined copy fails verification.

requirements.title: The mover never moves the last eligible copy
requirements.currentText: One keeper per group; never move the last copy.
requirements.proposedText: The mover never moves the last eligible copy. Every group retains one keeper.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover keeper selection and the last-copy guard.

requirements.title: The mover skips unsafe or ambiguous candidates
requirements.currentText: Skip groups with active date overrides on non-keeper copies, multiple overrides, hard links, empty files, files under 1 KB, changed or missing files, outside-root paths, or cross-volume renames.
requirements.proposedText: The mover skips and reports groups with active date overrides on non-keeper copies, multiple overrides, hard links, empty files, files under 1 KB, changed or missing files, outside-root paths, or cross-volume renames.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover changed, missing, hard-link, and outside-root cases.

requirements.title: Every move is auditable and the quarantine is never deleted
requirements.currentText: Write a journal line for every move. The app never deletes the quarantine folder.
requirements.proposedText: Every move writes a manifest entry, a journal line, and a `cleanup_moves` audit row. The app never deletes the quarantine folder.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the manifest, journal, audit rows, and migration.

requirements.title: A move batch updates the catalog and audit state
requirements.currentText: Moves are applied to the catalog in batches. The moved files rows are deleted, cleanup_moves keeps the audit record, duplicate groups are rebuilt, and destination adoption counters are refreshed.
requirements.proposedText: After a move batch, the moved catalog rows are deleted, `cleanup_moves` keeps the audit record, duplicate groups are rebuilt, and destination adoption counters are refreshed.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover row deletion, audit rows, duplicate rebuild, and counters.

requirements.title: A rescan does not report moved files as missing
requirements.currentText: A rescan therefore does not treat the moved files as missing.
requirements.proposedText: After a cleanup, a rescan does not report the moved files as missing because their catalog rows were removed with the move.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover catalog row deletion; no dedicated rescan-after-cleanup E2E yet.
requirements.notes: This is a good candidate for a new integration test.

requirements.title: Cancel, failure, and interruption leave an auditable run
requirements.currentText: Cancel stops after the current file. The run remains auditable if it is cancelled, fails, or is interrupted by an app restart.
requirements.proposedText: Cancel stops after the current file. A cancelled, failed, or interrupted run remains auditable through its journal, manifest, and cleanup run record.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover cancel and interrupted state.

requirements.title: The Move button is live; there is no preview-only phase
requirements.currentText: The Move button is live in the first release; no read-only preview phase and no settings toggle.
requirements.proposedText: The Move button is live in the first release. There is no preview-only phase and no settings toggle.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the live button and confirmation.

requirements.title: No user-defined protected folders in the first release
requirements.currentText: Scope: all eligible groups; no user-defined protected folders.
requirements.proposedText: The first release does not support user-defined protected folders. System paths `.memorylane` and `.memorylane_quarantine` are always excluded.
requirements.testNotes: No test: explicit non-goal.

requirements.title: No history or restore UI in the first release
requirements.currentText: Restore manually by copying files back and rescanning. History/restore is phase 2.
requirements.proposedText: The first release has no history or restore UI. Restore is a manual copy back plus a rescan.
requirements.testNotes: No test: explicit non-goal.

requirements.title: No automatic quarantine removal
requirements.currentText: The app never deletes the quarantine folder. Journal and DB audit; no automatic quarantine removal.
requirements.proposedText: The app never deletes the quarantine folder and never removes quarantine content automatically.
requirements.testNotes: No test: explicit non-goal.

requirements.title: Drive identity is stable and independent of the drive letter
requirements.currentText: The app must identify a drive independently of its drive letter.
requirements.proposedText: A drive is identified by a stable volume identity, not by its drive letter. The catalog validates the identity on open.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover identity and drive listing; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: A changed drive letter requires confirmation
requirements.currentText: If the same drive is reconnected with a different drive letter, ask the user to confirm before updating the catalog root.
requirements.proposedText: A changed drive letter is recognized by identity and requires explicit confirmation before the catalog root is updated. It is never treated as a new archive silently.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover changed-letter handling; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Each archive drive owns its catalog and cache
requirements.currentText: Each archive drive has its own independent SQLite database stored on that drive, separate from original folders.
requirements.proposedText: Each archive drive owns a self-contained `.memorylane/catalog.db` and app-managed cache, separate from original folders. The PC backup is a safety copy, not the owner.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover catalog creation and connections; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Scan starts only on explicit user action
requirements.currentText: The user explicitly starts the initial scan with a Start scan action. Do not automatically resume.
requirements.proposedText: A scan starts only on explicit user action. After interruption, resume is explicit; the app never resumes automatically.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover start, pause, resume, and UI state; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Scan runs four stages and browsing unlocks after catalog
requirements.currentText: Use a staged workflow: catalog, metadata, thumbnails, hashes. Do not require all stages to finish before browsing.
requirements.proposedText: A scan runs four ordered stages: catalog, metadata, thumbnails, hashes. Browsing unlocks after the catalog stage; later stages continue in the background.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests assert the four stages and stage order; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Pause persists progress and resume continues
requirements.currentText: Pause completes the current file or batch, persists progress, and stops scheduling new work. Resume continues from saved per-stage progress.
requirements.proposedText: Pause finishes the current file or batch, persists per-stage progress, and stops scheduling new work. Resume continues from that saved progress without recopying completed work.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover pause/resume and persisted session state; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Close or disconnect interrupts safely
requirements.currentText: If the app closes or the drive disconnects, stop safely, persist completed work, and require explicit resume.
requirements.proposedText: App close or drive disconnect marks the scan interrupted, preserves completed work, and requires explicit resume after reconnect.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover interruption and recovery; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Incremental scan detects new, changed, missing, and moved
requirements.currentText: A later scan detects new, modified, missing, and moved files; missing files are not removed automatically.
requirements.proposedText: An incremental scan adds new files, refreshes changed files, marks missing files, and proposes moved candidates. Missing files stay in the catalog.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover incremental reports and moved candidates; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Scan report counts new, changed, missing, and moved
requirements.currentText: ScanReport has newFiles, changedFiles, missingFiles, movedCandidates; report is non-null only when complete.
requirements.proposedText: A completed scan reports newFiles, changedFiles, missingFiles, and movedCandidates. The report is null until the scan completes.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests assert report shape and completion state; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Large files use a quick fingerprint until a full hash is needed
requirements.currentText: Large files without a same-size peer use a sampled fingerprint; full SHA-256 is computed when a duplicate/move candidate or replication/validation needs it.
requirements.proposedText: Files over the quick-hash threshold use a sampled fingerprint only until a full SHA-256 is required by a duplicate, move, replication, or validation decision. Existing full hashes are reused.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover quick hashing and full hashes; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Metadata extraction is versioned and refreshable
requirements.currentText: ExifTool is primary with dependency-free fallbacks; successful extraction records the extractor version.
requirements.proposedText: Metadata extraction uses ExifTool as the primary extractor with dependency-free fallbacks. Each success records the extractor version; stale metadata is reported and refreshed by an incremental scan.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover extraction and metadata refresh; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Dates preserve provenance and never invent a value
requirements.currentText: Resolve the best date, preserve precision, original value, source, and confidence; do not silently invent a date.
requirements.proposedText: Every resolved date preserves precision, the original extracted value, provenance, and confidence. A missing or suspicious date is shown as unavailable or flagged, never invented.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover date priority and precision; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Manual dates use year or year-month precision
requirements.currentText: Manual assignment accepts year or year/month; never invent a day; preserve the extracted date.
requirements.proposedText: Manual date assignment supports individual and bulk edits at year or year-month precision. It never invents a day, updates catalog metadata only, and preserves the extracted date for reversal.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover manual date precision and clearing; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Browsing and scanning stay responsive at 100k+ items
requirements.currentText: Use a virtualized grid, lazy thumbnails, indexed queries, and viewport-priority thumbnails; 100k/200k query passes.
requirements.proposedText: Browsing uses a virtualized grid, lazy thumbnails, and indexed queries. Visible thumbnails preempt bulk work. The 100k and 200k query budgets remain green.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover query budgets and thumbnail priority; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: One chronological timeline for photos and videos
requirements.currentText: Photos and videos are grouped together in one chronological timeline; filters all/photos/videos; ordering resolved_date DESC, file_id DESC; undated last.
requirements.proposedText: Photos and videos share one chronological timeline with all/photos/videos filters. Ordering is resolved_date DESC, then file_id DESC; undated items sort last.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover ordering and filters; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Year/month navigation and date grouping honor precision
requirements.currentText: Navigation by year and month; date grouping uses stored precision; Date unavailable is a trailing section.
requirements.proposedText: Year and month navigation anchor the timeline, and date-grouped sections use the stored precision: day, month, year, then Date unavailable.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover anchors and grouping; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: The grid is virtualized and thumbnails are lazy
requirements.currentText: Use a virtualized grid; load thumbnails lazily; prioritize visible items.
requirements.proposedText: The grid renders only visible rows and loads thumbnails lazily. Visible items preempt nearby and bulk thumbnail work.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover virtualization and thumbnail priority; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: The viewer supports photos, videos, and filter-aware navigation
requirements.currentText: Photos display in-app; videos play in-app; previous/next carries the active filter and density; Escape returns to the filtered grid.
requirements.proposedText: The viewer displays photos at fit/100% and plays videos natively. Previous/next carries the active filter and density, and Escape returns to the same filtered grid.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover viewer navigation and playback states; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Item details and missing states retain catalog context
requirements.currentText: Details include path, folder, timestamps, metadata, position, previous/next, media URL; missing files keep details with mediaUrl null.
requirements.proposedText: The viewer shows path, folder, timestamps, extracted metadata, position, previous/next, and the media URL. Missing or failed media keeps the catalog details and shows a clear unavailable state.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover details and missing states; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Media URLs use catalog IDs and byte ranges
requirements.currentText: Resolve files by ID, never accept a renderer path; serve only present files; support byte ranges and MIME; missing returns 404.
requirements.proposedText: `ml-media:` resolves catalog IDs, never renderer paths. It serves only present files, supports byte ranges and the cataloged MIME type, and returns 404 for missing files.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover ID resolution, ranges, and missing files; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Thumbnails are cached, deduplicated, and failure-safe
requirements.currentText: Serve a ready cache entry; otherwise generate on demand with interactive priority; deduplicate in-flight work; failures return 404.
requirements.proposedText: Thumbnails serve from cache when ready, otherwise generate on demand with interactive priority. In-flight work is deduplicated; failures return 404 so the grid shows a placeholder.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover cache hits, deduplication, and failures; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: HEIC previews are generated on demand and cached
requirements.currentText: HEIC/HEIF images generate a JPEG preview in a worker, cache it, and fall back to external open on failure.
requirements.proposedText: HEIC/HEIF images generate a JPEG preview on demand in a worker thread, cache it under `.memorylane/cache/previews`, and fall back to external open on failure.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover preview generation and failure fallback; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: WMV/3GP and failed playback use a cached MP4 proxy
requirements.currentText: WMV/3GP and failed direct playback use a cached H.264/AAC MP4; source changes invalidate; failure offers retry/external open.
requirements.proposedText: WMV, 3GP, and failed direct video playback use a cached H.264/AAC MP4 proxy. A source change invalidates the cache; failure offers retry and external open.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover proxy generation and failure states; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: The cache is disposable and never affects originals
requirements.currentText: Cache lives on the external drive, is excluded from PC DB backup, is disposable/regenerable, and clearing never affects originals or catalog entries.
requirements.proposedText: The generated cache lives on the external drive, is excluded from the PC database backup, and is disposable. Clearing it never changes an original file or a catalog row.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover cache clearing and regeneration; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Health summary reports duplicates, missing, moved, and validation state
requirements.currentText: HealthSummary covers duplicate groups, missing files, moved candidates, and validation state.
requirements.proposedText: The health summary reports duplicate groups, missing files, moved candidates, missing duplicates, and the current validation state in one place.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover the summary and handlers; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Duplicate detection uses exact full SHA-256 only
requirements.currentText: Exact SHA-256 duplicates across all present catalog files; sampled quick fingerprints are never duplicate evidence.
requirements.proposedText: Duplicate groups contain only files with the same full SHA-256. A sampled quick fingerprint is never duplicate evidence; a large file is fully hashed when another present or fully hashed missing file shares its size.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover exact grouping and full-hash promotion; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Duplicate groups list every copy with its context
requirements.currentText: Each HealthFile includes path, folder, media metadata, date, thumbnail URL, missing state, duplicate state, filesystem timestamps, verified-backup state, and active date-override state.
requirements.proposedText: Every duplicate group lists each present copy with path, folder, media metadata, date, thumbnail, missing state, filesystem timestamps, verified-backup state, and active date-override state.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover group members and UI badges; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Duplicate groups are ordered by total bytes
requirements.currentText: Group ordering is total bytes descending, then group id; page totals include excess bytes for eligible groups.
requirements.proposedText: Duplicate groups are ordered by total bytes descending, then group id. Page totals include the excess bytes for every eligible group.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover ordering and excess totals; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Duplicate groups are rebuilt after catalog changes
requirements.currentText: duplicate_groups and duplicate_members are rebuilt after scan finalize, on duplicate query, and after validation completes.
requirements.proposedText: Duplicate groups are rebuilt after scan finalize, after validation completes, and after catalog changes that can affect duplicates. Quick fingerprints never enter the group.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover rebuild points; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Missing files stay cataloged
requirements.currentText: Files no longer present are marked missing and are never removed from the catalog automatically.
requirements.proposedText: A file missing from its recorded path is marked missing and stays in the catalog. It is never removed automatically.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover missing marking and preservation; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Missing files can be disregarded and restored
requirements.currentText: Disregarding records dismissed_at, dismisses pending move suggestions, keeps the catalog row, and never changes source or backup files. Restore clears dismissed_at.
requirements.proposedText: A missing file can be disregarded, which records `dismissed_at`, dismisses its pending move suggestions, and keeps the catalog row. Restore clears the dismissal. Neither action changes a source or backup file.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover dismiss and restore; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Missing lists page and select across the full result
requirements.currentText: The missing list is offset-paged, includes fileIds for every matching file, and dismiss/restore accept up to 50,000 ids.
requirements.proposedText: The missing list is offset-paged and returns the IDs of every matching file so Select all covers more than the visible page. Dismiss and restore accept up to 50,000 IDs per request.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover paging and bulk selection; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Moved candidates are paginated and batch-confirmed
requirements.currentText: A pending moved candidate contains old path, new path, size, and SHA-256. The list is paginated; confirm is capped at 500, dismiss at 50,000.
requirements.proposedText: A moved candidate records old path, new path, size, and SHA-256. The list is paginated, confirm accepts at most 500 candidates per request, and dismiss accepts up to 50,000.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover candidate shape and paging; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Confirming a move rechecks and updates the catalog
requirements.currentText: Confirm flow rechecks the new path and hash in the main process, deletes the newly discovered duplicate row, updates the original row, clears missing state, and confirms the candidate.
requirements.proposedText: Confirming a move rechecks the new path and hash in the main process, deletes the newly discovered duplicate row, updates the original catalog row to the new path, clears missing state, and confirms the candidate.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover recheck and catalog update; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Dismissing a move keeps the file missing
requirements.currentText: Dismissing keeps the file missing and marks the candidate dismissed.
requirements.proposedText: Dismissing a moved candidate keeps the file missing and marks the candidate dismissed without changing the catalog path.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover dismissal state; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Missing-duplicate cleanup removes catalog rows only
requirements.currentText: Cleanup removes only eligible missing catalog rows with a full hash and a present same-hash/size peer; source and destination files are never touched.
requirements.proposedText: Missing-duplicate cleanup removes only eligible missing catalog rows that have a complete full SHA-256 and a present file with the same hash and size. Source and destination files are never touched, and adoption counters are refreshed.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover eligibility and catalog-only removal; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Missing-duplicate preview reports risk and pending moves
requirements.currentText: The preview reports pending move suggestions, verified backup replicas, and active date overrides.
requirements.proposedText: The missing-duplicate preview reports how many candidates have pending move suggestions, verified backup replicas, and active date overrides before cleanup.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover preview counts and warnings; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Validation has independently selectable levels
requirements.currentText: Validation supports existence, metadata, hash, and metadataRefresh levels, independently selectable.
requirements.proposedText: Validation offers four independently selectable levels: existence, metadata, hash, and metadataRefresh.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover level selection and state; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Validation covers the whole catalog and stores per-file results
requirements.currentText: Scope is the whole catalog; total checks = file count × selected levels; results are stored per session/level/file.
requirements.proposedText: Validation covers the whole catalog. Total checks equal the file count multiplied by the selected levels, and every result is stored per session, level, and file.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover totals and result storage; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Hash validation records mismatches and updates the stored hash
requirements.currentText: hash recomputes SHA-256; mismatch is recorded and the stored hash is updated to the actual value.
requirements.proposedText: Hash validation recomputes SHA-256, records a mismatch, and updates the stored hash to the actual value.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover mismatch and hash update; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Metadata refresh preserves manual date overrides
requirements.currentText: metadataRefresh re-extracts metadata through ExifTool, writes metadata and extracted dates, and preserves manual date overrides.
requirements.proposedText: Metadata refresh re-extracts metadata through ExifTool, writes metadata and extracted dates, and preserves every active manual date override.
requirements.testNotes: The scan-stage metadata test proves an active manual override survives a metadata save; the validation metadataRefresh path calls the same saveMetadata handler.

requirements.title: Validation marks missing files without deleting them
requirements.currentText: missing results mark files.state = 'missing' and insert missing_files.
requirements.proposedText: A missing validation result marks the file state as missing and inserts a `missing_files` row without deleting the catalog row.
requirements.testNotes: Candidate tests cover missing result persistence; not yet ID-tagged.

requirements.title: Validation pauses, resumes, and recovers
requirements.currentText: Pause, resume, shutdown-pause, stale-session recovery, and failure states are supported.
requirements.proposedText: Validation supports pause, resume, shutdown-pause, stale-session recovery, and explicit failure states.
